event_text: Per DailySecu, citing a threat-intel service, n0n lists Samsung as a victim
notes: Date only. A claim by the group, relayed by press and not confirmed.

event_text: DailySecu updates its article with Samsung's statement on the third-party vendor incident
notes: Time of the update, 6:06 AM Eastern the same day.

event_text: Cybernews first reports that n0n has dumped about 220MB of data it says is Samsung's
notes: Time of first publication, converted from UTC. The date the group posted the files is not given.

event_text: Cybernews adds the Samsung statement about the third-party vendor for Samsung Ads North America
notes: Date only. The page shows an update on Nov 20.
Time of publication, converted from UTC.

event_text: Per KPI News, citing threat-intel trackers, a different group, HYFLOCK, claims a 1TB "Samsung Group" breach
notes: Date only. A claim by the group, relayed by press and not confirmed; not linked to the vendor incident by any source.
